tokenizer.policy: no added-token recognition; no postprocessor; explicit EOS

contract.prefix_selection: First distinct eligible document hashes ascending within each split, first 512 tokens, no EOS.
contract.scope: Train-only teacher-activation local ridge fit; no gradient training, GDN, reinjection, auxiliary heads, adaptive depth, benchmark selection or architecture adoption.

allocation_scope: Donor modules retained for restoration; registered counts do not measure resident memory.
